notes: Corrected: the single *that* moves from הָיָה to the לְ of לָנוּס. Rule 45's complementizer belongs to a presentative frame the ASV has actually written, and this verse writes none; rule 52's finite recasting of לְ + infinitive (*that … may flee*) is the construction the ASV did write, and it puts the complementizer on the preposition. הָיָה and its waw are both left unrepresented.
*into three parts* is kept inside the unit of שִׁלַּשְׁתָּ, the one verb it renders.
